output.answer_or_partial: Three of Joanna’s writing contributions have made it to the big screen.
output.explanation: Joanna explicitly says the latest screening was the third time this had happened. Earlier conversations mention work that was still only hoped to reach the screen, so they do not add to the count.

evidence.quote: I know this is the third time it's happened, but its just so awesome!
Another movie script that I contributed to was shown on the big screen last Sunday for the first time!
I wrote a few bits for a screenplay that appeared on the big screen yesterday!
